The build lane must ship the sentence "dropped from the barrier; the agent keeps running and keeps its slot" and must NOT reuse the plan's word. Settling experiment: instrument `budget.spent()` immediately after a timeout fires and again after the workflow returns; a rise proves the agent lived on.
